title: Portfolio risk rules — non-blocking review follow-ups
description: Non-blocking finding from pr-reviewer's review of PR #11 (portfolio-risk-rules), tracked here per CLAUDE.md's autonomous-pipeline rule so it isn't lost once that PR merges.

checklist.step: The 'daily_ohlcv must be ordered oldest-first (most recent row last)' contract that protective_stop() relies on (via .tail()) is only documented in risk.py's own docstring. app/data/base.py's DataProvider.get_daily_ohlcv docstring says 'indexed by date' but doesn't state sort order explicitly — state it there too so a future data-provider implementation can't silently violate the contract this function depends on.
